title: Longest Palindrome By Concatenating Two Letter Words
statement:
Each word contains two lowercase letters and can be used at most once. Choose and order some words, then concatenate them into a palindrome. Return the maximum possible palindrome length.

## Examples

```text
Input: words = ["lc","cl","gg"]
Output: 6
```

```text
Input: words = ["cc","ll","xx"]
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= words.length <= 10^5`
- Each word has exactly two lowercase English letters
